composition_subtypes.role: binary search for optimal suffix start

payload.core_composition_summary: Two-pointer greedily builds prefix/suffix match positions in a for b; then binary search finds best split point to maximize kept length.
payload.rationale: The solution first computes prefix and suffix match arrays via amortized O(n) scans using two pointers (greedy). Then for each possible prefix length, binary search over the suffix array (monotonic in start index) to find the minimum suffix start satisfying non-overlapping condition in a, maximizing kept subsequence length.
